title: Errors
formulas: Mean absolute error: $\Delta a_{mean} = \frac{|\Delta a_1| + |\Delta a_2| + \cdots + |\Delta a_n|}{n}$.
Relative error $= \Delta a / a_{mean}$, and percentage error $= \frac{\Delta a}{a_{mean}} \times 100\%$.
keyPoints: The true value is reported as $a_{mean} \pm \Delta a_{mean}$; quoting more decimals than that interval is meaningless.
summary: Errors covers essential principles and applications.
examNotes: Focus on Errors problems - significant marks.
